coordinate_frame: Blue Raven launch-relative downrange/crossrange/up, not geographic east/north
attitude: Blue Raven sensor-frame quaternion, reordered vector-first to scalar-first; not transformed into RocketPy body/ENU frame

warnings: Blue Raven inertial navigation is not an independent position measurement; gyro saturation, deployment shocks and integration drift can make later positions, velocities and attitude unreliable. Review against barometric or GPS data.
Gyro readings approach the +/-2000 deg/s sensor range; attitude and inertial navigation after the first such reading may be unreliable.
Horizontal position integer rollovers were unwrapped, but this does not correct inertial-navigation drift.
